3.measure_note: HAND-RECONSTRUCTED GRID — say so plainly: this page is a FAX at -1.8 deg skew and the full-width rowbands.py scan returns ZERO rules (h_rules []), because no printed underline is horizontal across the full sheet. RECOVERY per the brief's --col path: restricting the scan to the amount column recovers the ladder — --col 82,92 gives 19.53, 23.44, 27.39, 31.22, 35.18, 39.14, 47.10, 51.00, 54.99, 58.97, 70.77, 82.36, 89.88 and --col 84,93 adds 74.69, 78.56, 86.07; the union fits a pitch of 3.9078 (19.53 -> 89.87 over 18 intervals) and the three positions the scan misses (43.12, 62.90, 66.84) are LINEARLY INTERPOLATED between their detected neighbours and are declared as such. The last two detected positions (86.07, 89.87) are the printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received' underlines, not data rows — so the 17 data rules end at 82.36 and the 17 filled rows use them all. THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE: row N spans [rule N-1, rule N]; row 1 is extrapolated one pitch up from 19.53 to 15.60. Column bands could not be measured on this page (no full-width rule carries segments) and are CARRIED FROM p4 of the same document — the same printed form in the same fax transmission, whose segments are Date 4.76-16.71, Name 18.24-52.49, Address 53.96-82.22, Amount 83.80-94.16 — with the amount band widened to 83.00-94.20 to absorb the skew. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: the row-1 box pct:83.0,15.60,11.2,3.93@p3 rendered '500.' with a raised '00' beneath the printed 'Amount' header (recorded 500.00, Utah County Democratic Party) and the row-17 box pct:83.0,78.56,11.2,3.80@p3 rendered '50.' with the raised cents loop at the right edge (recorded 50.00, Tracy Frandsen, the last filled row). A third control crop of the row-16 NAME band rendered 'Milo Andrus' — the row whose amount is 20.00 — confirming the ladder is not off by one in the middle of the page either.

4.measure_note: p4 lies nearly square in the fax (-0.1 deg) and scans cleanly: 17 data rules 19.64 -> 82.32 at a pitch of 3.9175 (62.68/16), each carrying the four per-column segments that ARE the column bands (Date 4.76-16.71, Name of Contributor 18.24-52.49, Mailing Address 53.96-82.22, Amount 83.80-94.16). Only the first 3 printed rows are filled; rows 4-17 are blank ruled lines and are NOT transcribed. Text sits above its underline, so row 1 is extrapolated one pitch up from 19.64 to 15.72. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi (all three rows effectively proved, the middle row being bounded by the two): the row-1 box pct:83.8,15.72,10.36,3.92@p4 rendered '519.' with a raised '48' under the printed 'Amount' header (recorded 519.48, Utah County Filing Fee) and the row-3 box pct:83.8,23.56,10.36,3.96@p4 rendered '30.' with raised '96' (recorded 30.96, Barber Metal). Note the independent agreement between the two pages: p4's measured ladder (19.64, pitch 3.9175) reproduces p3's reconstructed ladder (19.53, pitch 3.9078) to within 0.11 pct of page height.
